mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS review_id, r.member_id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname, r.visited_date AS visited_date, r.rating AS rating, r.content AS content, r.created_at AS created_at FROM spot_review r JOIN member m ON m.id = r.member_id WHERE r.spot_id = #{spotId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
